messages.campaign_fixture.quest.characters.title: Campaign fixture: recurring characters
messages.campaign_fixture.quest.characters.descri: Meet the existing villager cast as this campaign's mentor. All players share the same character.
This test chooses one adult villager near the saved village. Quests and scenes keep that identity through reloads and unloaded chunks.
campaign_fixture.quest.characters.remind: Reach the village marked by this quest. Exploring a closer village will not change the destination.
campaign_fixture.quest.characters.report: You returned to the same mentor. Another villager cannot finish this test, even when ordinary quests allow compatible providers.
messages.campaign_fixture.quest.characters.conver: You have returned. What do you need?
Will you help us find our way?
Ask the mentor to trust you.
I will help you find a way forward.
You will need to find another way.
